content_zh:
“小天，恭喜，终于开启体魄，成为俢者，十六年的努力，厚积薄发，以后成就不可限量啊！”龙河微笑道。
“河叔，全劳你平日教导有方，再加上那个畜生的功劳，才得以如愿所尝，将来有机会，天儿一定会好好报答你，报答那头畜生。”无天嘴角勾起一丝弧度，‘畜生’这两个字，说得特别重。
龙河笑容一僵，嘴巴一开一合，无声道：“我等着。”
而当说完这句话，他已经到了暴怒的边缘，不得已转身离开，深怕继续呆在这里，会控制不住情绪，当众出手。
现场一些人注意到龙河的离开，但并没太过在意，都围在无天身旁，笑语欢谈。
此刻仅剩下龙虎，超乎同龄人的他，比较成熟，不似其他孩子那般畏怯，毫不犹豫将元果扔进嘴里，嚼了几下，才吞进肚子，舔了舔嘴唇，还对大家扮了个鬼脸，一点都不担忧。
“野小子。”村民笑骂。
时过片刻，都没绽出一丝光芒，就在大家都充满失望之时，一道火红的光芒，自龙虎体内冲出，如一片火浪逆流而上，炎热笼罩龙村。
“这是…火元素灵体…”
“什么，不可思议，龙虎居然是元素灵体。”几个失败的孩子十分震惊，他们虽不能修炼，但对基础知识，倒是略知一二。
“哈哈，老天终于开眼了，赐予龙村一个元素灵体，今后村子的生活无忧矣！”村人欣喜若狂，老泪纵横，心里说不出的激动，他们也同样知晓元素灵体的重要性。
元素灵体非常罕见，龙村存在千年之久，至今也没出现过，如今这是第一次，大家都很激动。
“不错，罕见的火灵体，入火云宗正合适。”林山托着下巴，仔细打量着，脸上的笑意，代表他很满意。
龙虎抓着脑袋，傻笑不止，他虽有七尺高，但实际年龄也才十三岁，见众人因他而笑，故而一脸憨相。
“居然是元素灵体，真是难得。”无天惊叹，说不羡慕，有些太假。
对于元素灵体，轮回大陆的人无所不知，金木水火土光暗，这七大元素是天地本源，凡拥有七元素中任一元素体，未来的成就都难以预料，整体的资质方面比普通体魄，高不止百倍。
“有意思，这种小山村竟会出现元素灵体。”火烈鸟背上，那一直没说话，平静无奇的少女，在此刻，美貌的脸上，有了诧异。
“确实无法想象，偌大的宗门，元素灵体都少得可怜，不料在这里碰见一个，没白跑这一趟。”旁边，华服少年笑道。
少女浅笑道：“火师兄所言极是，此人带回宗门后，精心培养，十年后，在青龙洲百宗大赛中，定能取得不错的成绩。”
“不错，火云宗专修火系秘典，身为火灵体的人，修炼起来事半功倍。师妹，事不宜迟，即刻带人回宗，免得节外生枝。”少年笑着说道，但眉头却皱了起来。

“火师兄，你是怕此人身为火灵体的事情暴露，炎宗会半道抢人。”
华服少年点头，眼中浮出一抹凝重，似乎对所谓的炎宗，极为忌惮。
少女黛眉拧起，思忖少许，点头同意。
华服少年跃下火烈鸟，对着林山说道：“林长老，既然都已经测试，那带着龙虎，我们立刻回去。”
“这么快？”
林山错愕，以往前来招收弟子，都会暂住一日，岂料今日这么快便要离开，但少宗主都已经吩咐了，他也不敢反驳，于是问道：“少宗主，那无天呢？”
“他即已成为俢者，虽只是普通体魄，但也符合记名弟子的标准，就随我们一同回宗。”说到此处，少年看着脏兮兮，散发着臭味的无天，眉头一蹙，道：“你赶紧去整理下。”
“劳烦稍等片刻。”无天拱手，瞥了眼远处的龙河，搀着爷爷，朝着家中走出，完全没理会，正处于兴奋状态的村人。
待无天离开后，华服少年再度望向林山，沉声道：“林长老，为了安全起见，我们还是兵分两路，你带着龙虎先走，以你的实力，我相信一定能把他安全带回去。”
话都说到这个份上，林山自然知道了少宗主的用意，也明白其在担心什么，没有犹豫，手掌一挥，一头白虎凭空出现，能有三米长，模样狰狞，凶威阵阵。

content_en:
"Xiaotian, congratulations, you finally opened up your body and became a warrior. After sixteen years of hard work and accumulation, your achievements in the future will be limitless!" Long He said with a smile.
"Uncle He, it's all thanks to your good teaching and that beast's contribution that I was able to taste what I wanted. If there is a chance in the future, Tian'er will definitely repay you and repay that beast." The corners of Wutian's lips curled up, and the word 'beast' was spoken with great emphasis.
Long He's smile froze, his mouth opened and closed, and he said silently: "I'm waiting."
And when he finished saying this, he was on the verge of rage and had no choice but to turn around and leave. He was deeply afraid that if he continued to stay here, he would lose control of his emotions and attack in public.
Some people at the scene noticed Long He's departure, but didn't pay much attention. They all gathered around Wu Tian, ​​laughing and talking.
At this moment, only Longhu was left. He was more mature than his peers and was not as timid as other children. He threw the Yuanguo into his mouth without hesitation, chewed it a few times before swallowing it, licked his lips, and made a face to everyone. He was not worried at all.
"Wild boy." The villagers laughed and scolded him.
After a while, no light shined out. Just when everyone was filled with disappointment, a fiery red light rushed out from Longhu's body, like a wave of fire going upstream, and the heat enveloped Longcun.
"This is...the fire element spirit..."
"What, it's unbelievable, Dragon and Tiger are actually elemental spirits." Several failed children were shocked. Although they couldn't practice, they did know a little bit about the basic knowledge.
"Haha, God finally opened his eyes and gave Longcun an elemental spirit body. From now on, the village's life will be worry-free!" The villagers were ecstatic, with tears streaming down their faces. They were indescribably excited. They also knew the importance of elemental spirits.
Elemental spirits are very rare. Dragon Village has existed for thousands of years and has never appeared before. Now this is the first time and everyone is very excited.
"Yes, the rare fire spirit body is suitable for joining the Fire Cloud Sect." Lin Shan held his chin and looked at it carefully. The smile on his face meant that he was very satisfied.
Longhu scratched his head and kept giggling. Although he was seven feet tall, his actual age was only thirteen years old. When he saw everyone laughing because of him, he looked stupid.
"It's really an elemental spirit. It's really rare." Wutian marveled, saying he wasn't envious would be a bit false.
People in the Samsara Continent know everything about elemental spirits. Metal, wood, water, fire, earth, light and darkness. These seven elements are the origin of heaven and earth. Anyone who possesses any of the seven elements will have unpredictable future achievements. The overall qualifications are more than a hundred times higher than ordinary bodies.
"It's interesting that elemental spirits can appear in such a small mountain village." On the back of the flamingo, the girl who had been silent and calm had surprise on her beautiful face at this moment.
"It's really unimaginable that in such a large sect, there are so few elemental spirits. Unexpectedly, I met one here. This trip was not in vain." Next to him, the young man in colorful clothes said with a smile.
The girl smiled lightly and said: "What Senior Brother Huo said is absolutely true. After this person was brought back to the sect, he was carefully trained. Ten years later, he will definitely achieve good results in the Qinglong Continent Hundred Sect Competition."
"Yes, the Fire Cloud Sect specializes in cultivating the secret code of the fire system. As a person with a fire spirit body, you can practice with twice the result with half the effort. Junior sister, without further ado, take people back to the sect immediately to avoid any complications." The young man said with a smile, but his brows wrinkled.
"Senior Brother Huo, you are afraid that the fact that this person is a fire spirit body will be exposed, and the Yan Sect will rob him half-heartedly."
The young man in rich clothes nodded, with a solemn look in his eyes, as if he was extremely afraid of the so-called Yan Zong.
The girl frowned, thought for a moment, and nodded in agreement.
The handsome boy jumped off the flamingo and said to Lin Shan: "Elder Lin, since everything has been tested, let's take Longhu with us and go back immediately."
"So fast?"
Lin Shan was shocked. In the past, when he came to recruit disciples, he would stay for a day. Unexpectedly, he had to leave so soon today, but the young sect leader had already given the order, and he did not dare to refute it., so he asked: "Young Sect Leader, what about Wutian?"
"He has become a disciple. Although he has only an ordinary physique, he still meets the standards of a registered disciple, so he will return to the sect with us." At this point, the young man looked at Wutian who was dirty and smelly, frowned, and said, "Hurry up and clean up."
"Please wait a moment." Wutian cupped his hands, glanced at Long He in the distance, supported his grandfather, and walked out of his home, completely ignoring the excited villagers.
After Wutian left, the young man in Chinese clothes looked at Lin Shan again and said in a deep voice: "Elder Lin, for the sake of safety, we should divide our troops into two groups. You take Longhu first. With your strength, I believe you can bring him back safely."
Having said this, Lin Shan naturally understood the young sect leader's intention and what he was worried about. Without hesitation, he waved his hand and a white tiger appeared out of thin air. It could be three meters long, with a ferocious appearance and fierce power.
